shared_elements: low-relief carving on a boulder/monument surface
curvilinear scrolled outlines forming a face or mask-like motif
paired symmetrical forms flanking a central element
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief carvings on rounded boulder faces built from broad curvilinear scrolls, hooked volutes and round bosses that read as eyes within a mask-like or zoomorphic composition filling the whole exposed face. The clearest difference is that A's design is organised into a register-like band of repeated round-eyed units with vertical dividing lines, whereas B's is a single large sweeping curved motif with a downward-hooked element, so the specific composition and any narrative content cannot be matched.
